title: Extract payment-method persistence and QR logic
statusReason: Payment-method CRUD and public-safe QR/listing logic now have a canonical owner, the isolated Replit database tests pass, and existing route authorization/response adapters remain in place.
commit: 9d2265005539307911672cb7ba17f2047c1de5c4; working tree contains the phase changes and is not committed.
objective: Move payment-method persistence, default management, public-safe listing, labels, and QR generation out of invoice routes and the legacy invoice helper while preserving route behavior and compatibility exports.

oldToNewMapping.from: lib/finance-invoice.ts: payment method labels, QR generation, and active public listing

migratedConsumers.status: Imports the canonical owner. requireAuth, PEP ownership/authorization middleware, route status codes, date formatting, and the existing default-reset-before-authorization ordering are retained.
Uses the canonical active-method listing and re-exports the established QR, label, and public-method symbols for compatibility.

databaseTestIsolation.target: Replit development database, explicitly selected as replit-test
databaseTestIsolation.runner: Creates a uniquely named isolated schema, applies allowlisted Finance table DDL, runs tests, and drops the schema.

commands.result: The new test incorrectly assumed the public active-method listing used CRUD ordering; the assertion was corrected to identify the default by method type.

The new owner check initially treated generic getRateMap/toBase functions in unrelated AI/net-worth modules as duplicate report use cases; those helpers were excluded from the report-use-case ownership assertion.

commands.command: Start application workflow: API build, frontend build, and API server on port 5000
commands.result: Workflow restarted and remained running. API and frontend builds succeeded; Vite emitted non-blocking sourcemap/chunk-size warnings.

commands.command: curl GET /api/finance/summary and GET /api/finance/payment-methods without a session
commands.result: Both endpoints returned HTTP 401, as expected for unauthenticated requests.

invariants.name: Default selection on create
invariants.status: Database characterization confirms creating a new default clears the user's prior default.

invariants.name: Default reset before PEP authorization on update
invariants.status: The existing route ordering remains unchanged; this intentionally unusual side-effect ordering is not altered or represented as a safe authorization design.

invariants.name: Public payment-method exposure
invariants.status: Database characterization confirms inactive rows are excluded, default state is returned as a boolean, and QR output is produced for bank and mobile-money methods.

invariants.name: Authentication
invariants.status: Both payment-method route smoke requests returned HTTP 401 without a session. Authenticated route behavior was not exercised.

runtimeVerification.result: The API listened on port 5000, the root page rendered, and both unauthenticated Finance route smoke checks returned 401. Authenticated Finance UI was not visually verified.

limitations: PASS applies only to this low-risk payment-method leaf extraction, not completion of the Finance target tree.
Authenticated HTTP response contracts and PEP policy behavior still require route-level tests.
Payment-method changes preserve existing behavior, including the update default-reset ordering; no schema migration was performed.
Money-moving ledger, schedule, invoice lifecycle, fee, job, and wallet-bridge extraction remains blocked by missing rollback, retry/idempotency, and authorization invariants.
No Finance service cutover was performed.

diffReview.singleOwnerAndCompatibility: The Finance boundary scan verifies payment-method function ownership, route imports, and the legacy finance-invoice compatibility export.

nextSafeStep: Keep money-critical modules in their existing owners until the FIN-03 rollback, retry/idempotency, concurrency, and authorization test gates pass.
